subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “She still wanted to sing next year, but she had learned something important: a performance needs more than…”?
options: It is also what was saved.
It is also about where people stopped.
Quiet support can also deserve applause.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It is also what was saved.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is also their home.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is also about where people stopped.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「She still wanted to sing next year, but she had learned something important: a performance needs more than performers. Quiet support can…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「She still wanted to sing next year, but she had learned something important: a performance needs more than performers. Quiet support can also deserve…」，答案為「Quiet support can also deserve applause.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Quiet support can also deserve applause.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
